title: aidd validate --json
description: What `aidd validate --json` prints: whether the files validate, each error and warning, and the next step.

schema_version.description: The version of this output's shape. A new key keeps it; a renamed, removed, or retyped key bumps it.

passed.description: True when there is no error: the exit code is 0.

errors.description: Each error, naming the file it is in (all but a missing config).

warnings.description: Each warning, without its `warning: ` prefix: worth fixing, never failing.

next_step.description: What to do next when there is an error; null when there is none.
